chunks: If the الهلال disappears before the twilight, then it is for one night; and if it disappears after the twilight, then it is for two nights.
2. Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Murazim, from his father, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
If the الهلال becomes encircled, then it is for two nights; and if you see the shadow of your head in it, then it is for three nights.

Because the proper understanding of these two reports, and others that run along the same meaning, is that they only serve as an indicator for considering the beginning of the month when there is some impediment in the sky, such as clouds and the like. In that case, it is permissible to consider it for the coming night by the encircling of the الهلال and its setting before or after the twilight. But when the impediment has cleared and the sky is clear, then these things are not to be considered. This is similar to what we mentioned regarding the testimony of two men from outside the town, for it is only considered when there is an impediment; and whenever there is no impediment, it is not permissible to consider that in any way. Rather, one then needs the testimony of fifty persons, according to what we mentioned earlier. This interpretation upon which we have understood these two reports was only stated so that the reports would not be dismissed, even though the more precautious position is what has preceded, and upon it action must be based, if Allah wills.

key_terms.الشَّفَقِ: the twilight after sunset, used here as a time marker for the moon’s setting
key_terms.الْهِلَالُ: the new crescent moon used to determine the start of the lunar month
key_terms.تَطَوَّقَ: became encircled; a visible feature of the crescent treated as an indicator of age
key_terms.دُخُولِ الشَّهْرِ: the commencement of the lunar month
key_terms.شَهَادَةِ خَمْسِينَ نَفْسًا: the testimony of fifty persons as a stronger evidentiary requirement
key_terms.عِلَّةٌ: an obstructing condition, such as clouds, affecting visibility in the sky

ai.seo_question: When can the shape or setting time of the الهلال be used to determine the start of the lunar month?
ai.summary: This text discusses legal indicators for determining the beginning of the lunar month through observation of the الهلال. It explains that such signs are only considered when the sky is obscured, while in clear conditions they are not relied upon, and stricter evidentiary standards apply.
